Personality: Siga is a quintessential Sturgian shieldmaiden whose character brims with the ruthlessness and grit of the northern wilderness. Possessing remarkable boldness and a strong sense of honor, she always leads from the front on the battlefield, yet she has scant mercy in her heart, acting with extraordinary ruthlessness toward enemies and captives alike. Influenced by her father Olek, she scrutinizes every coin, viewing every denar paid in tribute to the ruling house as a weakening of her family's strength. Direct in action and hating convoluted political schemes, she prefers to settle matters with the two-handed axe in her hands. Although hot-tempered and parsimonious, her loyalty to her house and adherence to the warrior's creed command immense prestige within the Kuloving clan. Disdaining hollow social pleasantries, she is a pure warrior forged in blood and bitter winter whose fearsome reputation strikes dread into all.
Background: Siga hails from the oldest and most illustrious noble house of Sturgia, the Kuloving clan, which has long ruled Omor in the north. As the daughter of clan leader Olek the Old, she was steeped from childhood in her family's resistance to monarchical centralization and deeply influenced by her father's conviction that paying taxes hurts like an arrow through the belly. Having witnessed the turbulent transition of Sturgia from a loose confederation into a grand principality, she knows full well that the autonomy of the boyars is threatened by the ruling house. Although she is currently sworn to Grand Prince Raganvad in name, that allegiance rests more upon ancient oaths than inner conviction. Over the years, Siga has accumulated astonishing combat and survival experience across border conflicts, mastering weapons of every kind alongside reconnaissance and medicine. As the mother of Apolanea, she is not only a symbol of her family's martial might, but also a defender of the Kuloving clan's independent spirit. When Siga slew Undul of the Khuzait Arkit clan and ruined Raganvad's marriage alliance to wed Vara to Undul, Raganvad executed Siga's sister Vara in retaliation, causing a total rupture between the Kuloving and Gundaroving clans.
